description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs: DeviationRunResult::findings contains Pass and NotApplicable findings from the inner LintRunner, not just undeviated actionable findings. The doc comment does not call this out. Callers who check has_findings() expecting it to reflect only Warn/Error/Fatal may be surprised. Doc-only fix: clarify that findings mirrors the full LintRunner output (including Pass/NotApplicable) minus any findings that were moved to deviated.
title: DeviationRunResult doc omits that findings includes Pass/NotApplicable
